text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Bronchitis with possible occupational asthma component. The combination of a chronic productive cough, significant smoking history, landscaper occupation, and confirmed airflow obstruction (FEV1/FVC < 70%) without reversible asthma features points toward chronic bronchitis, potentially exacerbated by environmental irritants. While the Methacholine challenge was normal, ruling out classic bronchial hyperreactivity, your symptoms could still be driven by chronic inflammation or a specific hypersensitivity to plant/chemical allergens common in landscaping. Given the hyperinflation on X-ray and the chronic nature of your symptoms, this aligns with early-stage COPD (Chronic Bronchitis phenotype).
